semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Hiroshima University is involved in semiconductor education and research, contributing to talent development and industry advancement.
summary: Hiroshima University is engaged in semiconductor education and research through its dedicated centers. It focuses on developing human resources and advancing semiconductor technologies via its Department of Semiconductor Integrated Science and the Research Institute for Semiconductor Industry Technology. The university collaborates with industry consortia and international partners to enhance its educational initiatives.
capabilities: Development of advanced human resources in device and process technologies
Research and development in semiconductor industry technology
Training initiatives for semiconductor industry advancement
Collaboration with international partners for semiconductor education

regional_presence.Japan: Hiroshima University is based in Japan and actively collaborates with local industry consortia.
regional_presence.United States: The university has established an overseas campus in partnership with the University of Idaho to enhance semiconductor education.
